decision_basis: Two independent Docker canonical-build cycles produced the same zte_tpd.ko SHA-256.
Candidate and stock AArch64 assembly have identical 69 instructions, 276-byte symbol size and resolved relocations, including the inline callback-check path.
Candidate and stock KCFI type IDs are identical: 0xc3d43b4d.
Strict Joern gate passed with zero parse problems and one-to-one source/Ghidra identity coverage using the recorded compatibility defines.
The dedicated ASAN/UBSAN contract passed 4/4 cases in both reproducible cycles, covering parse failure, same-state suppression, state transition and callback/no-callback behavior.
review_findings: Joern retains two high-severity synchronization findings.
